locator: Misconceptions about evolutionary theory, natural selection, trees, and population genetics

variants.en: Every process in biological evolution is entirely random.
variants.zh: 生物进化中的所有过程都完全随机。

correction.en: Evolution includes random processes and nonrandom selection.
correction.zh: 进化既包括随机过程，也包括非随机选择。

variants.en: Evolution always makes every lineage more complex and superior.
variants.zh: 进化总会使每个谱系更复杂和更优越。

correction.en: Evolution has no universal ladder of progress; complexity can decrease.
correction.zh: 进化没有普遍的进步阶梯，复杂性可以降低。

variants.en: An individual animal's growth during its lifetime is population-level evolution.
variants.zh: 动物个体一生中的成长就是种群层面的进化。

correction.en: Individual development differs from changes in inherited population traits across generations.
correction.zh: 个体发育不同于种群遗传性状的跨代变化。

variants.en: Evolution can never be observed over short timescales.
variants.zh: 在短时间尺度内永远无法观察到进化。

correction.en: Rapid evolution has been observed, especially in organisms with short generations.
correction.zh: 快速进化已被观察到，尤其在世代短的生物中。

variants.en: Genetic drift cannot occur in a large population.
variants.zh: 大种群中不可能发生遗传漂变。

correction.en: Drift occurs in populations of all sizes but is stronger in smaller ones.
correction.zh: 任何大小的种群都会漂变，小种群中的效应更强。

variants.en: Natural selection changes genes because organisms deliberately try to adapt.
variants.zh: 自然选择因为生物故意努力适应而改变基因。

correction.en: Selection acts on existing variation and differential reproduction, not intentions.
correction.zh: 选择作用于已有变异和繁殖差异，而不是意图。

variants.en: Natural selection automatically gives a species every trait it needs.
variants.zh: 自然选择会自动赋予物种所需的每种性状。

correction.en: Needed variation may be absent; selection has no foresight and extinction can occur.
correction.zh: 所需变异可能不存在；选择没有预见，物种可能灭绝。

variants.en: Evolutionary fitness means physical strength and nothing else.
variants.zh: 进化适合度只意味着身体力量。

correction.en: Fitness concerns reproductive success in a particular environment.
correction.zh: 适合度涉及特定环境中的繁殖成功。

variants.en: Natural selection always creates organisms perfectly suited to every condition.
variants.zh: 自然选择总能造成完美适应所有条件的生物。

correction.en: Trade-offs, history, and changing environments prevent perfect universal adaptation.
correction.zh: 权衡、历史和变化的环境阻止完美的普遍适应。

variants.en: Every biological trait must be an adaptation produced by natural selection.
variants.zh: 每一种生物性状都必须是自然选择造成的适应。

correction.en: Traits can also reflect drift, historical constraints, or by-products of other traits.
correction.zh: 性状也可能反映漂变、历史限制或其他性状的副产物。

variants.en: Taxa placed next to each other at tree tips must be the closest evolutionary relatives.
variants.zh: 进化树末端相邻的类群必然是最近的亲缘类群。

correction.en: Branching structure and common ancestors determine relatedness, not tip order.
correction.zh: 分支结构和共同祖先决定亲缘，而不是末端顺序。

variants.en: Every inherited trait is controlled by exactly one genetic locus.
variants.zh: 每种遗传性状都恰好由一个基因座控制。

correction.en: Many traits depend on multiple loci and their interactions.
correction.zh: 许多性状取决于多个基因座及其相互作用。
